# Panel

The content box.

`LL.Panel` · Components · Containers

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Panel>…</LL.Panel>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Panel">…</x-import>
```

## Props (PanelProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `titleAlign` | `'start' \| 'end'` |  |
| `aside` | `React.ReactNode` | Right side of the header: a Tag, a count. |
| `flush` | `boolean` | No body padding: a List or table inside runs edge to edge, and its rows take the Panel's inset, so they align with the title. A Panel has no edge of its own,… |
| `density` | `'comfortable' \| 'standard' \| 'compact'` | Padding follows the density: 24, 16 or 12px; one step less when the Panel sits inside another surface (the Folio, a Banner). |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
